path_4_challenge_registry.description: Defines the Student Challenge Registry: how learner-reported issues (e.g., 'I believe the answer is wrong') are tracked, investigated, and resolved, with full link-back to question identity and certification history.

challenge_registry_schema.status: Enum: OPEN | TRIAGE | INVESTIGATING | REMEDIATION_PLANNED | REMEDIATED | VERIFIED | CLOSED | DISMISSED
challenge_registry_schema.priority: Enum: P1 (Critical — wrong answer) | P2 (High — misleading feedback) | P3 (Medium — missing content) | P4 (Low — cosmetic)
challenge_registry_schema.compound_key: String — full compound identity as defined in S203 navigation model
challenge_registry_schema.learner_description: String — the learner's own words describing the issue
challenge_registry_schema.investigation_type: Enum: WRONG_ANSWER | MISSING_FEEDBACK | MISLEADING_FEEDBACK | BROKEN_UI | TIMER_ISSUE | OTHER

resolution.type: Enum: ANSWER_KEY_FIX | EXPLANATION_FIX | METADATA_FIX | UI_FIX | NO_ACTION (explanation provided to learner)
resolution.verified_by: String — agent or session that verified the fix

challenge_registry_schema.question_certification_state_at_filing: String — snapshot of question_state when challenge was filed

challenge_lifecycle.1_filed: Learner submits challenge via platform. System captures QID, compound_key, session_state, learner description.
challenge_lifecycle.2_triage: Triage bot checks: (a) is question Certified? (b) does a known defect already cover this? (c) has an identical challenge been filed before? Routes to appropriate priority.
challenge_lifecycle.3_investigation: Investigator opens deep-link view: question detail, certification history, all sessions referencing the QID, all open recommendations, defect library entries. Independent re-derivation of answer if answer-key challenge.
challenge_lifecycle.4_remediation: If confirmed: create recommendation, link to target session, add to remediation pipeline. If not confirmed: close with explanation to learner.
challenge_lifecycle.5_verification: Post-remediation: independent agent verifies fix. Re-runs applicable gates. Updates question_state if needed.
challenge_lifecycle.6_closed: Closure evidence recorded. REVISION_HISTORY.md entry appended. Learner notified.

example_challenge_on_known_defect.learner_complaint: I calculated the 4th unit time using the learning curve formula and got 64 hours, but the platform says 51.2 hours is correct. The explanation references 8^(-0.3219) which seems wrong — shouldn't it be 4^(-0.3219)?
example_challenge_on_known_defect.resolution: DL-030 confirmed. CC corrected B→C. Explanation updated. Learner's calculation was correct.
